primary_diagnosis: Chronic Dyspepsia with Suspected Peptic Ulcer Disease (PUD)
clinical_reasoning: A 6-7 month history of diffuse abdominal burning, early satiety, epigastric tightness, and postprandial pain below the chest indicates chronic peptic disease. The persistence of symptoms and anorexia over half a year warrants urgent diagnostic upper GI endoscopy to evaluate for gastric or duodenal ulceration and rule out mucosal malignancy.
recommended_tests: Upper GI Endoscopy (Esophagogastroduodenoscopy) with mucosal biopsy
Complete Blood Count (CBC) to screen for microcytic anemia
